# Sales Compensation Plan FY26 - Current

## New ARR Commission

Account executives earn 8% commission on eligible new annual recurring revenue.

Eligible new annual recurring revenue excludes professional services, training,
tax, and pass-through expenses.

Commission is calculated only after the order form is signed and booked in CRM.

## Accelerator Rule

The 12% accelerator applies only after the rep reaches 100% of quarterly quota.

Pipeline forecast, verbal commit, or unsigned order form does not trigger the
accelerator.

## Exception Approval

Any manual exception to commissionable ARR requires written VP Sales approval
and Finance approval.

If approval is missing, the commission packet must be routed for review.
